prompt.en: Explain why a sheet of epithelial tissue is unable to support the body weight of a large animal or to resist heavy pulling forces during movement.

label.en: Why a covering tissue cannot bear load

level1.en: Describe the structure of epithelial tissue and explain why that structure is unsuited to bearing mechanical load.

clue.en: In tissues that bear load, most of the strength lies in the material between the cells. How much of that material does epithelium contain?

level2Template.en: Epithelium is built to cover and to line, so it ___.

accepted: lacks the strong extracellular matrix that bears load
has almost no matrix between its cells
is not specialised for mechanical support
has no fibrous material to resist pulling forces

text.en: Epithelial cells are packed tightly together with very little material between them.
Load is borne by the matrix of a connective tissue, and epithelium ___.
